62978-neighbourhood-a-year-s-life-in-and.creator: Tickner Edwardes
62978-neighbourhood-a-year-s-life-in-and.description: A book by Tickner Edwardes. Bower—A New Song and an  Old Story. Whitsunday—God’s House  Beautiful—The Soul-Shepherd. Ringing the Bees—An  old-fashioned Bee-Garden. Corpus Christi: an Impression. The Old Brier-Bush—Chaffinch  and Willow-Wren—The  Mowing-Grass—The First Wild  Rose. Rainy Days—Old Times and  New—The Reverend’s  Garden—Darkie and his Den. The Cotter’s Saturday  Night—The Cricket  Committee—Summer Gloaming. Summertide—The Teasel  Traps—Bees in the  Tares—Poppies and Wheat—The  Oat-field—Swifts.

arxiv-1808-09900.title: Early Lessons from a Voice-Only Interface for Finding Movies Conference: Late-Breaking Results track part of the Twelfth ACM Conference on Recommender Systems; October 2–7, 2018; Vancouver, BC, Canada Late-Breaking Results track part of the Twelfth ACM Conference on Recommender Systems (RecSys ’18),
arxiv-1808-09900.creator: Joshua Wissbroecker, F. Maxwell Harper
arxiv-1808-09900.description: Abstract . The current generation of streaming media players often allow users to speak commands (e.g., users can change the TV channel by pressing a button and saying “ESPN”). However, these devices typically support a narrow range of control- and search-oriented commands, and do not support deeper recommendation or exploration queries.

arxiv-2106-00057.title: BGG categories in prime characteristics
arxiv-2106-00057.creator: Henning Haahr Andersen
arxiv-2106-00057.description: Abstract . Let 𝔤 \mathfrak{g} be a simple complex Lie algebra. In this paper we study the BGG category 𝒪 q \mathcal{O}_{q} for the quantum group U q ​ ( 𝔤 ) U_{q}(\mathfrak{g}) with q q being a root of unity in a field K K of characteristic p > 0 p>0 .

arxiv-2204-04320.title: Numerical Simulations of Nearly Incompressible Viscoelastic Membranes
arxiv-2204-04320.creator: Valeria Barra, Shawn A. Chester, Shahriar Afkhami
arxiv-2204-04320.description: Abstract This work presents a novel numerical investigation of the dynamics of free-boundary flows of viscoelastic liquid membranes. The governing equation describes the balance of linear momentum, in which the stresses include the viscoelastic response to deformations of Maxwell type.

arxiv-2301-11902.title: Tree-structured Policy Planning with Learned Behavior Models
arxiv-2301-11902.creator: Yuxiao Chen, Peter Karkus, Boris Ivanovic, Xinshuo Weng, Marco Pavone
arxiv-2301-11902.description: Abstract Autonomous vehicles (AVs) need to reason about the multimodal behavior of neighboring agents while planning their own motion. Many existing trajectory planners seek a single trajectory that performs well under all plausible futures simultaneously, ignoring bi-directional interactions and thus leading to overly conservative plans.

arxiv-2302-05324.title: SOCRATES: Text-based Human Search and Approach using a Robot Dog
arxiv-2302-05324.creator: Jeongeun Park, Jefferson Silveria, Matthew Pan, Sungjoon Choi
arxiv-2302-05324.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose a SOCratic model for Robots Approaching humans based on TExt System ( SOCRATES ) focusing on the human search and approach based on free-form textual description; the robot first searches for the target user, then the robot proceeds to approach in a human-friendly manner. In particular, textual descriptions are composed of appearance (e.g.

arxiv-2306-05290.title: Noncommutative scalar field theory in a curved background: duality between noncommutative and effective commutative description
arxiv-2306-05290.creator: Marija Dimitrijević Ćirić, Nikola Konjik, Andjelo Samsarov
arxiv-2306-05290.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Marija Dimitrijević Ćirić, Nikola Konjik, Andjelo Samsarov. We study a noncommutative (NC) deformation of a charged scalar field, minimally coupled to a classical (commutative) Reissner–Nordström-like background. The deformation is performed via a particularly chosen Killing twist to ensure that the geometry remains undeformed (commutative). An action describing a NC scalar field minimally coupled to the RN geometry is manifestly invariant under the deformed U ​ ( 1 ) ⋆ U(1)_{\star} gauge symmetry.

arxiv-2306-08381.title: Quasi-Stable Structures in Equilibrium Dense Bismuth Melt: Experimental and First Principles Theoretical Studies
arxiv-2306-08381.creator: B.N. Galimzyanov, A.A. Tsygankov, A.V. Suslov, V.I. Lad’yanov, A.V. Mokshin
arxiv-2306-08381.description: Abstract Near the melting temperature, equilibrium bismuth melt is characterized by structural features that are absent in equilibrium monatomic simple liquids. In the present work, the structure of bismuth melt is studied by X-ray diffraction experiments and quantum chemical calculations.

arxiv-2308-08413.title: Knowledge-Enhanced Multi-Label Few-Shot Product Attribute-Value Extraction Conference: Proceedings of the 32nd ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management; October 21–25, 2023; Birmingham, United Kingdom. Proceedings of the 32nd ACM International Conference on Information an
arxiv-2308-08413.creator: Jiaying Gong, Wei-Te Chen, Hoda Eldardiry
arxiv-2308-08413.description: Abstract . Existing attribute-value extraction (AVE) models require large quantities of labeled data for training. However, new products with new attribute-value pairs enter the market every day in real-world e-Commerce. Thus, we formulate AVE in multi-label few-shot learning (FSL), aiming to extract unseen attribute value pairs based on a small number of training examples.

arxiv-2312-14857.title: Investigation of the correlation between optical and γ \gamma -ray flux variation in the blazar Ton 599 2015 Investigation of the correlation between optical and γ \gamma -ray flux variation in the blazar Ton 599 – References
arxiv-2312-14857.creator: Bhoomika Rajput, Amit Kumar Mandal, Ashwani Pandey, C. S. Stalin, Walter Max-Moerbeck, Blesson Mathew
arxiv-2312-14857.description: Abstract The correlation between optical and γ \gamma -ray flux variations in blazars reveals a complex behaviour. In this study, we present our analysis of the connection between changes in optical and γ \gamma -ray emissions in the blazar Ton 599 over a span of approximately 15 years, from August 2008 to March 2023.

arxiv-2409-19949.title: Task-Agnostic Pre-training and Task-Guided Fine-tuning for Versatile Diffusion Planner
arxiv-2409-19949.creator: Chenyou Fan, Chenjia Bai, Zhao Shan, Haoran He, Yang Zhang, Zhen Wang
arxiv-2409-19949.description: Abstract Diffusion models have demonstrated their capabilities in modeling trajectories of multi-tasks. However, existing multi-task planners or policies typically rely on task-specific demonstrations via multi-task imitation, or require task-specific reward labels to facilitate policy optimization via Reinforcement Learning (RL). They are costly due to the substantial human efforts required to collect expert data or design reward functions.

arxiv-2411-07714.title: Typed Non-determinism in Concurrent Calculi: The Eager Way
arxiv-2411-07714.creator: Bas van den Heuvel a, Daniele Nantes-Sobrinho b, Joseph W.N. Paulus c, Jorge A. Pérez d
arxiv-2411-07714.description: Abstract We consider the problem of designing typed concurrent calculi with non-deterministic choice in which types leverage linearity for controlling resources, thereby ensuring strong correctness properties for processes. This problem is constrained by the delicate tension between non-determinism and linearity. Prior work developed a session-typed π \pi -calculus with standard non-deterministic choice; well-typed processes enjoy type preservation and deadlock-freedom.

arxiv-2502-16999.title: Stable time rondeau crystals in dissipative many-body systems
arxiv-2502-16999.creator: Zhuocheng Ma, Jin Yan, Hongzheng Zhao, Liang-You Peng
arxiv-2502-16999.description: Abstract Driven systems offer the potential to realize a wide range of non-equilibrium phenomena that are inaccessible in static systems, such as discrete time crystals. Time rondeau crystals with a partial temporal order have been proposed as a distinctive prethermal phase of matter in systems driven by structured random protocols.

arxiv-2503-09392.title: Diagnostic Systems in the Muon g-2 Experiment at Fermilab
arxiv-2503-09392.creator: M. Sorbara
arxiv-2503-09392.description: Abstract The muon anomalous magnetic moment, a μ = g − 2 2 a_{\mu}=\frac{g-2}{2} , is a low-energy observable which can be both measured and computed to high precision, making it a sensitive test of the Standard Model and a probe for new physics. This anomaly was measured with a precision of 0.20 0.

arxiv-2509-03781.title: Plasmons in a network of topological states in twisted bilayer graphene
arxiv-2509-03781.creator: Brian S. Vermilyea, Michael M. Fogler
arxiv-2509-03781.description: Abstract We study surface plasmons in minimally-twisted bilayer graphene that contains a triangular network of partial dislocations (or AB-BA domain walls) hosting one-dimensional electronic states. We calculate plasmon dispersion by solving classical equations of motion for charge dynamics on the network links with impedance boundary conditions at the network nodes.

arxiv-2510-15847.title: Bio-inspired Microgrid Management based on Brain’s Sensorimotor Gating
arxiv-2510-15847.creator: Panos Papageorgiou, Anastasios E. Giannopoulos, Sotirios T. Spantideas
arxiv-2510-15847.description: Abstract Microgrids are emerging as key enablers of resilient, sustainable, and intelligent power systems, but they continue to face challenges in dynamic disturbance handling, protection coordination, and uncertainty. Recent efforts have explored Brain Emotional Learning (BEL) controllers as bio-inspired solutions for microgrid control.

arxiv-2511-16960.title: On Solving Chance-Constrained Models with Gaussian Mixture Distribution
arxiv-2511-16960.creator: Shibshankar Dey, Sanjay Mehrotra, Anirudh Subramanyam
arxiv-2511-16960.description: Abstract We study linear chance-constrained problems where the coefficients follow a Gaussian mixture distribution. We provide mixed-binary quadratic programs that give inner and outer approximations of the chance constraint based on piecewise linear approximations of the standard normal cumulative density function.

arxiv-2603-00392.title: Dissipation and microstructure in sheared active suspensions of squirmers
arxiv-2603-00392.creator: Zhouyang Ge 1, Gwynn J. Elfring 2

europmc-pmc10515021.creator: Sun T, Rao S, Zhou X, Li L.
europmc-pmc10515021.description: Carotenoids are isoprenoid metabolites synthesized de novo in all photosynthetic organisms. Carotenoids are essential for plants with diverse functions in photosynthesis, photoprotection, pigmentation, phytohormone synthesis, and signaling. They are also critically important for

pmc-10655115.title: Comparative analysis of the intestinal microbiome in Rattus norvegicus from different geographies
pmc-10655115.creator: Taif Shah, Yutong Hou, Jinyong Jiang, Zahir Shah, Yuhan Wang, Qian Li, Xiang Xu, Yixuan Wang, Binghui Wang, Xueshan Xia
pmc-10655115.description: Rat species Rattus norvegicus, also known as the brown street rat, is the most abundant mammal after humans in urban areas, where they co-exist with humans and domestic animals. The reservoir role of R. norvegicus of zoonotic pathogens in cities among rodent-borne diseases that could endanger the lives of humans and other mammals. Therefore, understanding the normal microbiome of R.

pmc-11715849.title: Cerebrovascular and Metabolic Alterations in a Mouse Model of Familial Alzheimer’s Disease Carrying the Notch3 C456R Mutation
pmc-11715849.creator: Leila Letica, Sang‐Ho Choi, Lauren R Dubberley, Diego Szczupak, Jung Eun Park, David J Schaeffer, Afonso C Silva
pmc-11715849.description: BackgroundVascular pathology associated with small vessel disease (SVD), such as microinfarcts and microbleeds, are common in elderly populations and significant contributors to cognitive impairment and dementia. Autosomal dominant cerebral arteriopathy with subcortical infarctions and leukoencephalopathy (CADASIL), caused by mutations in the Notch3 gene, is the most prominent inheritable SVD, with a common etiology of subcortical strokes and dementia.

pmc-12368240.title: Potato-onion intercropping enhances tomato yield and quality and modifies soil microbial diversity
pmc-12368240.creator: Xingjia He, Aijia Zhang, Chenning Sha, Fengzhi Wu, Kejun Yang
pmc-12368240.description: Intercropping can promote sustainable agricultural development and increase economic benefits by enhancing ecosystem stability, soil health, and resource use efficiency. In this study, we analyzed the effects of tomato monoculture and tomato/potato-onion intercropping on tomato root distribution and bacterial and fungal communities in tomato rhizosphere by stratified subsection excavation method, quantitative PCR, and Illumina MiSeq sequencing.

pmc-12566374.title: Iron-Doped Molybdenum Sulfide Nanoflowers on Graphene for High-Performance Supercapacitors
pmc-12566374.creator: Xuyang Li, Mingjian Zhao, Shuyi Li, Shiyuan Cheng, Yiting Zuo, Kaixuan Wang, Meng Guo, Carlos Alemán
pmc-12566374.description: Supercapacitors (SCs) are widely acknowledged for their high-power density as energy storage devices; designing electrode materials with both high efficiency and exceptional energy density remains a significant challenge. In this study, a flower-like iron-doped molybdenum sulfide on graphene nanosheets (FMS/G) was synthesized through a simple, efficient, and scalable solvothermal approach.

pmc-12785069.title: Radiotherapy for Liver-Confined Hepatocellular Carcinoma in Elderly Patients with Comorbidity
pmc-12785069.creator: Sun Hyun Bae, Young Seok Kim, Sang Gyune Kim, Jeong-Ju Yoo, Jae Myeong Lee, Sanghyeok Lim, Jae Hong Jung, Chan Kyu Kim
pmc-12785069.description: Simple SummaryThe incidence of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is increasing among elderly populations, and its management in these patients has become a globally emerging issue. Elderly patients often present with multiple comorbidities that affect treatment tolerance and outcomes, and the optimal management strategy for elderly patients with HCC has not yet been established.

pmc-12824234.title: Processing of natural scenes in the human pulvinar
pmc-12824234.creator: Daniel R. Guest, Emily J. Allen, Kendrick N. Kay, Michael J. Arcaro
pmc-12824234.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Theories of high-level visual processing and object recognition have typically focused on ventral visual cortex, often overlooking potential contributions of subcortical structures. The pulvinar, via extensive connections with visual cortex, is well-positioned to play a role in high-level vision. Here, we investigated how the pulvinar represents visual information using a high-resolution 7 T fMRI dataset of responses to tens of thousands of natural scenes.

pmc-13084826.title: Sex differences in risk factor control and medication adherence post-ACS: insights from the TEXTMEDS randomised clinical trial
pmc-13084826.creator: Shiva Raj Mishra, Simone Marschner, Haeri Min, Shehane Mahendran, Aravinda Thiagalingam, Rohan Poulter, Julie Redfern, David B Brieger, Peter L Thompson, Graham S Hillis, Nicholas Collins, Pratap Shetty, Michele McGrady, Christian Hamilton-Craig, Nadarajah Kangaharan, John Atherton, Andrew Maiorana,
pmc-13084826.description: IntroductionPoor adherence to risk factor control and life-saving medications is a key factor affecting long-term patient prognosis. Evidence indicates that sex plays a significant role in the uptake of both pharmacological and non-pharmacological interventions, ultimately influencing long-term outcomes. This study aimed to quantify sex differences in risk factor management and medication adherence following acute coronary syndrome (ACS).

pmc-13146319.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A1866 CARDIOVASCULAR RISK FACTORS MEDIATE SOCIOECONOMIC INEQUALITIES IN STROKE OUTCOMES IN A 30-YEAR CAUSAL MEDIATION ANALYSIS FROM THE SOUTH LONDON STROKE REGISTER (SLSR)
pmc-13146319.creator: Camila Pantoja Ruiz, Anita Lindmark, Eva S Emmett, Matthew Dl O’connell, Charles Wolfe, Iain Marshall
pmc-13146319.description: Background and aimsSocioeconomic inequalities in post-stroke outcomes persist, but causal mechanisms remain unclear.We used counterfactual mediation analysis to quantify these pathways.MethodsWe included all first-ever stroke patients from the South London Stroke Register (1995-2025), stratified by decade. Socioeconomic status (SES) was measured using Index of Multiple Deprivation quintiles(1-2 vs 3-5).

pmc-13293622.title: Epigenetic orchestration of sugar signaling in plant development and stress adaptation
pmc-13293622.creator: Ping Zhao, Yi Liu, Javeria Abid, Xingtan Zhang, Noor-ul Ain
pmc-13293622.description: Sugars are not only metabolites but also signals that gate plant growth, fruit ripening, and stress responses. Carbon-sensing pathways (HEXOKINASE 1, TOR-SnRK1, and the sucrose Trehalose-6-phosphate pathway) reprogram gene expression by engaging DNA methylation, histone modification, chromatin remodeling, regulatory RNAs, and RNA modifications.

pmc-13334293.title: Evaluation of the Flashtest multiplex qPCR system for rapid pre-laboratory screening for African swine fever infection
pmc-13334293.creator: Marek Walczak, Łukasz Adaszek
pmc-13334293.description: IntroductionAfrican swine fever (ASF) is a devastating viral disease of domestic pigs and wild boar. As no safe vaccine is currently available, prevention relies primarily on strict biosecurity measures. Early diagnosis is essential to reduce the risk of ASF spread. Among the available methods, qPCR is considered the gold standard and is recommended by the World Organisation for Animal Health.

pmc-13365141.title: Symptom burden in young adult brain tumor survivors: Key intervention targets based on patient-reported outcome network analyses
pmc-13365141.creator: Charlotte Sleurs, Floortje Mols, Laurien De Roeck, Rhodé M Bijlsma, Suzanne E J Kaal, Jacqueline M Tromp, Monique E M M Bos, Tom van der Hulle, Ann Hoeben, Janine Nuver, Mathilde C M Kouwenhoven, Winette T A van der Graaf, Olga Husson
pmc-13365141.description: BackgroundA brain tumor can lead to functional impairment, which is particularly concerning for adolescents and young adults (AYA). Patient-reported outcomes (PROs) have typically been examined as isolated domains, rather than as covarying symptoms. This study modeled PRO networks, symptom clustering, and topology among AYA oncology survivors.

pmc-13437521.title: Beyond national fertility rates: unmasking territorial differences in adolescent pregnancy in Ecuador
pmc-13437521.creator: Mónica Izurieta-Guevara, Erika Lozano-Erazo, Sami Sánchez-Verduga, Cristina Núñez-Vásquez, Lorena Izurieta-Guevara, Emmanuelle Quentin
pmc-13437521.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionTeenage pregnancy is a significant public health challenge that may contribute to cycles of poverty in the context of social inequality. In Latin America and the Caribbean, Ecuador ranks third in terms of fertility rates.

pmc-13468514.title: Machine learning-assisted computation of the solubility of solid drugs in supercritical carbon dioxide
pmc-13468514.creator: Wenrui Ban, Bing Zhang, Chuying Wang, Yuxing Zhang, Zhiqiang Cheng, Haoyu Wang, Zheng Zhu
pmc-13468514.description: This research applies three types of machine learning models, i.e., artificial neural network models (radial basis function, multi-layer perceptron, cascade feed-forward, and Elman recurrent neural networks), adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference systems, and least-squares support vector machines, to determine the solubility of twenty-eight solid drugs in supercritical carbon dioxide (scCO2).

pmc-13476643.creator: Xi Xie, Yanan Peng, Qiang Gao, Bin Li, Guolin Jiang, Nan Wang, Ruixue Song, Jingjing Ma, Kai Cheng, Jianbo Zhang, Chunyi Wang, Yuan Bian, Rugang Liu, Chang Pan, Rui Shang, Marcus Eng Hock Ong, Wen Zheng, Feng Xu

pmc-13542672.title: Hepatotoxic Potentials of Food Additives on Liver Enzymes and Tissues of Wistar Rats
pmc-13542672.creator: Ude Ugomma, Okorie Nnaemeka, Uzor Simon, Kalu Micheal, Okekpa Simon, Valentine Nyirahafashimana, Usanga Victor, Mmesomachi Bethel Uche, Obi Ihuoma, Onwe Doris, Iyke-Ogbo Pauline, Onwudiwe Victor
pmc-13542672.description: BackgroundFood additives such as monosodium glutamate (MSG), sodium benzoate (SB), and Sunset Yellow (SY) are widely consumed and have been linked to adverse hepatic effects. However, the available evidence is largely derived from in vitro or single-additive studies, with limited comparative in vivo data integrating biochemical and histopathological outcomes under uniform experimental conditions.

pmc-13563750.title: Relationship between nursing notes sentiment scores and length of hospital stay in elderly knee osteoarthritis patients undergoing total knee arthroplasty: a retrospective observational study
pmc-13563750.creator: Qingmei Wu, Qin Feng, Yiyang Liu, Wen Wang, Minyan Song, Fei Pan, Yufei Shao, Wei Zhang
pmc-13563750.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundWith ongoing population aging, the prevalence of knee osteoarthritis (KOA) keeps increasing in the elderly population. For end-stage KOA patients, total knee arthroplasty (TKA) remains the definitive and effective treatment. Although numerous studies have examined factors associated with length of hospital stay (LOS) in TKA patients, these investigations predominantly focus on patient characteristics and surgical variables, often overlooking the “human factor” within the nursing process.
